Experience / 02

Two co-op terms · 16 months · Alberta utilities

I learned to build around real operations.

My co-op work put me between business requirements, operational data, and the systems people depend on. I learned to ask better questions, test the failure paths, and leave software maintainable for the next person.

01 / Most recentMay—Dec 2025

Apex Utilities Inc.

Leduc, Alberta

Operations Applications Co-op

Redesigned an Alberta One-Call integration as the organization migrated from IBM Maximo to MAS 9, transforming XML locate tickets into work orders used to dispatch field crews.

  • Updated Node-RED field mappings and SOAP requests for the new enterprise environment.
  • Integrated Amazon S3 image uploads, attachment links, and API-key authentication over HTTPS.
  • Tested five ticket types plus malformed XML, bad dates, and simulated upload failures before rollout.

Node-RED · JavaScript · XML · SOAP · Amazon S3 · IBM MAS 9
